F031.summary: Claude Agent SDK client configured with model aliases, retry logic, error classification, and connection timeout

SDK client setup.detail: Uses @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk's query function. ClaudeProvider class implements AgentProvider interface with executeQuery AsyncGenerator.

Model selection.detail: MODEL_ALIASES maps haiku/sonnet/opus to full model IDs (claude-haiku-4-5, claude-sonnet-4-5, claude-opus-4-6). Falls back to raw model string if no alias match.

Tool permissions configured.detail: SDK options include cwd, maxTurns, permissionMode. DEFAULT_TOOLS exported from @nomos-ai/types. Permission modes: default, acceptEdits, bypassPermissions, plan.

Error handling.detail: classifyError categorizes errors into auth/rate_limit/timeout/network/server/validation/unknown with retryable flags. MAX_RETRIES=3 with exponential backoff and jitter.

F032.summary: Agent session creation service initializes sessions in DB with feature context, system prompt, and tool config

Session created in DB.detail: createAgentSession creates session via sessionRepository.create with userId, featureId, status, model, etc.

Agent initialized with context.detail: loadProjectContext loads project context. AgentConfig includes model, tools, systemPrompt, maxTurns, cwd, permissionMode.

System prompt includes feature.detail: buildSystemPrompt constructs detailed prompt with feature ID, title, description, acceptance criteria, spec, technical notes, testing requirements.

F033.summary: Agent execution with streaming via AsyncGenerator, capturing text/tool calls/thinking tokens in real-time

Agent runs in worktree.detail: cwd option in SDKOptions passed to query(). Agent execution supports custom working directory for worktree isolation.

Output streams in real-time.detail: ClaudeProvider.executeQuery returns AsyncGenerator<ProviderMessage>. Yields messages as they arrive from SDK stream.

Tool calls captured.detail: ProviderMessage type includes tool call events. Agent output viewer and tool-call-display components handle rendering.

Thinking tokens tracked.detail: THINKING_TOKEN_BUDGET from @nomos-ai/types. ThinkingLevel configuration (none/standard/extended/ultrathink). ThinkingBlock component renders thinking content.

F034.summary: WebSocket server with events and terminal channels, connection management, and authentication

WebSocket server setup.detail: Bun native WebSocket via createWebSocketHandlers. Two channels: 'events' (broadcast) and 'terminal' (per-session). Server exports websocket handlers.

Connection handling.detail: open/message/close handlers. Events channel uses broadcaster pub/sub. Terminal channel tracks clients per sessionId in Map<string, Set<WebSocket>>.

Authentication.detail: extractWsUserId reads session from auth cookie on WebSocket upgrade. Falls back to 'anonymous'. userId attached to WSData.

Message routing.detail: Events broadcast to all event subscribers. Terminal input routed to correct session via terminalService.write(). Terminal output forwarded to session-specific WebSocket clients.

F035.summary: Agent output WebSocket streaming via EventBroadcaster with typed events, backpressure handling, and error cleanup

Output streams to clients.detail: EventBroadcaster subscribes to EventService. Serializes events to JSON and broadcasts to all connected WebSocket clients.

Events typed correctly.detail: Events include type and payload. Client-side WebSocketClient parses JSON and distributes to typed handlers.

Backpressure handled.detail: EventBroadcaster checks ws.bufferedAmount > 1MB before sending. Skips clients with high buffer. Client-side uses exponential backoff for reconnection (1s-30s).

Errors propagated.detail: Failed sends cause client removal. JSON serialization errors caught. Client-side has onError handler and automatic reconnection on close.

F036.summary: Agent output viewer with markdown rendering, collapsible tool calls, thinking blocks, streaming indicator, and auto-scroll

Markdown formatted text.detail: Uses react-markdown with rehype-sanitize for safe HTML rendering. Messages rendered as formatted markdown.

Collapsible tool calls.detail: ToolCallDisplay component imported and used for each tool call in messages. Pending tool calls also rendered.

Thinking indicator.detail: ThinkingBlock component renders thinking content. StreamingIndicator shows when agent is actively streaming.

Auto-scroll and copy.detail: bottomRef auto-scrolls to bottom on content changes. Copy button extracts all text content including thinking blocks.

F037.summary: Tool call visualization with category badges, duration formatting, diff viewer for file operations, and collapsible details

Tool calls displayed.detail: ToolCallDisplay renders tool name, input, result, duration. Uses Wrench icon, ChevronDown/Right for expand/collapse.

Duration tracking.detail: formatDuration converts ms to human-readable (e.g., '1.2s'). Uses startedAt/completedAt from tool call data.

Diff viewer for file ops.detail: extractDiffData extracts old/new values from Write and Edit tool calls. DiffViewer component shows file changes. isFileModifyingTool from tool-categories lib.

Category badges.detail: getToolCategory from tool-categories lib categorizes tools. Badge component displays category.
